title: cymbopogon reflexus
intro: Cymbopogon reflexus, commonly known as East Indian Lemongrass, is a type of grass native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of East Indian Lemongrass include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its wide range of applications. The bioactive constituents of Cymbopogon reflexus include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in aromatherapy and herbal remedies.
